# Lei Gao

Official public research identity and verification hub:
https://leigao-research.github.io/leigao-research/

Lei Gao is an AI Governance and Human Oversight researcher and Visiting Research Fellow at the Centre for Asian and Transcultural Studies (CATS), Heidelberg University, 2026-2027.

Research topics:
- AI Governance
- Human Oversight
- Agentic AI
- Responsible AI
- System Dynamics
- Algorithmic Friction
- Smart Sustainable Cities
- Digital Governance

Verification sources on the site include:
- Heidelberg University Visiting Research Fellow invitation (public redacted copy)
- System Dynamics Society ISDC 2026 proceedings
- Elsevier / Finance Research Letters
- ITU smart sustainable cities and FG-AI4SSC institutional portals
- Public GitHub research repositories
